extracted.intended_audience: people interested in taking improv classes (aspiring comedians, actors, people wanting to improve public speaking), prospective Second City students
extracted.subtask_description: Overview and guidance for choosing and taking improv classes at The Second City Training Center, including class types, levels, locations, and the benefits of improv for various goals (comedy, acting, public speaking).

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicability of improv to non-comedians
rubrics_metrics.description: "Improv classes aren’t just for aspiring comedians. Whether you’re perfecting your stand-up or improving your public speaking the benefits of improv can apply to anyone."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use improv training not only to develop comedic performance but also to improve other skills such as stand-up technique and public speaking; consider your personal goal (e.g., comedy vs. communication) when choosing classes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Variety & class types (level and focus)
rubrics_metrics.description: "The Second City offers a variety of improv classes from Improv for Actors to Improv Drop in classes for newbies, there’s a class for everyone."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select a class that matches your experience and focus: beginner-friendly drop-in classes for newcomers, specialized classes (e.g., for actors) for role-specific skills; instructors and class curricula will differ by class type and level.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formats and locations available
rubrics_metrics.description: Page lists multiple delivery formats and locations (Online Classes, Chicago, Toronto, New York, Kids & Teens Camps, Drop-In Classes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose the format and location that suit your availability and needs (in-person vs. online, adult vs. kids/teens programming); check class search and location details to find offerings that fit schedule and demographic.
